title: Balanced XP Bottler
description: Convert XP into vanilla Bottles o' Enchanting with configurable tax, cost, cooldown, and bulk stack conversion.
body:
Balanced XP Bottler adds a fair way to store experience in vanilla Bottles o' Enchanting without turning XP banking into an exploit.

How it works:
- Sneak + Right Click with the configured input item (default: `minecraft:glass_bottle`) converts exactly 1 bottle.
- Keep holding Sneak + Right Click, and after the hold timer (default: 3 seconds / 60 ticks), the mod converts all remaining possible bottles from your XP and input stack.
- Conversion is based on absolute XP points (not levels), preventing level-scaling abuse.

Key features:
- 1 click = 1 bottle.
- Hold-to-bulk conversion after configurable delay.
- Configurable XP cost per bottle.
- Configurable tax percentage (XP loss on conversion).
- Configurable cooldown to prevent spam/autoclick abuse.
- Configurable input item (`item_used`).
- Vanilla XP bottle output with stored XP value.
- Sound and particle feedback on conversion.
- Server-side logic for multiplayer-safe behavior.

Server config options:
- `xp_cost_per_bottle` - XP points removed per bottle.
- `tax_percentage` - conversion loss in percent.
- `cooldown_ticks` - delay between conversion actions.
- `hold_to_bulk_ticks` - hold duration before bulk conversion starts.
- `item_used` - required input item id (default: `minecraft:glass_bottle`).
